properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 reaches this repo through three transitive chains: (1) @ethersproject/pbkdf2@5.8.0 ← @ethersproject/hdnode (BIP39 mnemonic→seed) and @ethersproject/json-wallets (encrypted-keystore KDF) — ethers v5 dev/peer via hardhat-ethers; (2) pbkdf2@^3.0.17 + @types/pbkdf2 ← ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 (dev, browser-crypto polyfill); (3) the lockfile declaration site. No direct PBKDF2 call in the SDK's own code; dev toolchain only; no iteration counts configured anywhere in this repo.
